data.sTitle: Zenless Zone Zero website DNA — technical handbook (single page)
data.sIntro: Technical handbook of the Zenless Zone Zero official website: structure, tokens, components, interactions, source and originals.
data.sContent:
Single-page technical handbook. Everything around this text is the original Zenless Zone Zero site running from the originals archive on this host: the shell, the chunks, the header, the news template, the footer SDKs, the fonts. Only one answer of the content API was replaced — the record of this page (iInfoId 7013) is this handbook. Specimens inside the page are verbatim markup captured from the live site, styled by the site's own stylesheets, so their hover states are the real ones. The only normalisation applied to specimens is the removal of inline opacity/transform/transition values that Swiper and GSAP write during motion, so each specimen is shown in its settled state.

How to read: OBSERVED = read from shipped code or responses · MEASURED = reported by headless Chromium on 2026-10-03 · INFERRED = interpretation, never a fact · RULE FOR A CHILD SITE = transferable instruction derived from the above.

Downloadable editions: PDF (printed handbook with contents, index and the full code appendix) · Markdown. Both are generated from the same chapter sources as this page.

01 // SCOPE, EVIDENCE RULES AND HOW TO READ THIS PAGE

This handbook describes the Zenless Zone Zero official website at https://zenless.hoyoverse.com/zh-cn/main to a depth of one navigation step, on both of its trees: the desktop tree under /zh-cn/… and the phone tree under /m/zh-cn/… that the site itself serves to mobile user agents. 17 desktop pages and 9 mobile pages were captured in headless Chromium on 2026-10-03; every number, class name, colour and file name in these chapters comes from the shipped code, from the responses the pages received, or from measurements taken in that browser.

OBSERVED — Desktop pages captured: redemption, /zh-cn/character?id=166076, /zh-cn/company/privacy, /zh-cn/company/terms, /zh-cn/main, /zh-cn/news, /zh-cn/news/166475, /zh-cn/news/166476, /zh-cn/news/166496, /zh-cn/news/166497, /zh-cn/news/166498, /zh-cn/news/166535, /zh-cn/video, /zh-cn/world, /zh-cn/world/102173, /zh-cn/world/102257, /zh-cn/world/102370.

OBSERVED — Mobile pages captured (iPhone user agent, 390×844 CSS px, device pixel ratio 2): /m/zh-cn/character, /m/zh-cn/company/privacy, /m/zh-cn/company/terms, /m/zh-cn/main, /m/zh-cn/news, /m/zh-cn/news/166535, /m/zh-cn/video, /m/zh-cn/world, /m/zh-cn/world/102370.

How to read: OBSERVED = read from shipped code or responses · MEASURED = reported by headless Chromium · INFERRED = interpretation, never a fact · RULE FOR A CHILD SITE = transferable instruction derived from the above. Where a value is given in rem, the root font-size is the one the site computes from the viewport (chapter on rendering scale); the bracketed pixel values are for a 1440 px wide desktop window and a 390 px wide phone.

What is not in scope: the pages behind the "更多" (more) menu that live on other hosts (充值 at sdk.hoyoverse.com/payment, 攻略 at act.hoyolab.com), the account pages at account.hoyoverse.com that open in an iframe when the user icon is clicked, and the game itself. The redemption page at /redemption is on this host but is a separate build (it loads its own bundles from act.hoyoverse.com); it is described where the nav reaches it and archived with the originals.

Desktop and phone are two parallel trees: /:lang/… and /m/:lang/…; the inline script in the shell head sends phone user agents to the /m/ tree before Vue starts, which is why the phone capture of /zh-cn/main landed on /m/zh-cn/main.

The header navigation and where each entry goes

MEASURED — Header entries at 1440 wide: 首页 · 角色介绍 · 影像资料 · 新闻资讯 · 设定档案 · 更多 · 立即下载. Clicking 角色介绍 / 影像资料 / 新闻资讯 / 设定档案 changed the route to /zh-cn/character, /zh-cn/video, /zh-cn/news, /zh-cn/world without a document reload (performance navigation entries stayed at 1), in 1971 ms, 1807 ms, 1649 ms, 1425 ms from click to route change. The logo click from /zh-cn/video returned to /zh-cn/main.

MEASURED — Hovering 更多 opens a sub-menu with 3 links: 兑换码 → https://zenless.hoyoverse.com/redemption; 充值 → https://zenless.hoyoverse.com/payment; 攻略 → https://act.hoyolab.com/zzz/event/e20240601-guide-c0k2vt/index.html.

03 // TECHNICAL STRUCTURE: NUXT 2 SHELL, WEBPACK 4 CHUNKS, INJECTED CSS, SDKS

OBSERVED — Stack read from the shipped code: Nuxt 2 in SPA mode (window.__NUXT__ holds only {config:{_app:{basePath:"/",assetsPath:"/_nuxt/",cdnURL:null}}}, no server-rendered state), Vue 2.7.4 runtime, vue-router, Vuex, vue-meta (the data-n-head attributes in the shell), webpack 4 (window.webpackJsonp chunk loading, public path "/_nuxt/"), Swiper 4.5.1 for every carousel, GSAP with ScrollTrigger for scroll-driven motion, axios behind a HoYoverse request layer, lodash, date-fns, vant and pdf.js inside the vendor bundle, and the HoYoverse SDKs loaded as separate scripts: jquery 1.11.1 (dependency of the SDK scripts), hoyoverse-account-sdk, hoyoverse-footer, analysis v2, and the APM helper.

04 // RENDERING SCALE: THE REM ADAPTER (100 × CLIENTWIDTH ÷ DESIGN WIDTH)

OBSERVED — Every length in the stylesheets is in rem. A plugin in the app bundle (module 326) sets the root font-size from the viewport: fontSize = 100 × clientWidth ÷ designWidth, with the design width 2560 for the desktop tree and 750 for the phone tree. On desktop the client width is clamped to [1440, 2560] before the division (minScaleWidth 1440, maxFillWidth 2560), so a window narrower than 1440 px keeps the 1440 layout and scrolls horizontally rather than shrinking; on phones the height (designHeight 1334) is used in landscape. The plugin also adds the class pc or mo to <html>, adds hairlines when the device pixel ratio is at least 2, and only then sets #__nuxt visible.

「治安局秩序督察，赛维里安·洛威尔。不必寒暄了，现在情况如何？」

「你们说大魔…呃，洛威尔长官？等、等等…他不在附近吧？你们确定？…好，那我就直说了！我从没见过他笑！他是真正的、真正的、真正的恶魔！」

——谨慎观察周围后，说话声越来越小、又陡然大叫起来的希希芙

「大家都说，『赛维里安·洛威尔长官是所有治安官的榜样』。但我…好吧，虽然听起来有点可笑，但他不是我的榜样。如果『他能按照自己说好的时间回家』？那也不是！」

——赛斯

「黑枝的档案里有他的资料。呃，这会不会有点夸张…我知道要『避免与之发生冲突』，但也不用最大字号、红色字体，加粗标注三次吧？」

——菲欧妮

「长官他…好像会在大家出外勤的时候，给我的番茄和青衣前辈的绿植浇水？虽然我没有证据。我暂时还无法想象和他讨论任何工作以外的问题…」

——朱鸢

让我们重新认识空洞
空洞是毁灭世界的灾难，是一种凭空出现、吞噬一切的异常球体空间，其内部时空环境因未知效应的影响变得紊乱无序，还会产生被称为“以骸”的危险异形生物。普通人迷失在空洞里不仅要面对恐怖异形的袭击，自身也会有发生侵蚀变异的危险。
但是！请广大市民们不用担心，新艾利都已经完全掌握了管控空洞灾害的技术！甚至还拥有从空洞中采掘贵重的以太资源的能力！新艾利都就是空洞灾害时代的奇迹，是大家唯一的选择！


空洞危险吗？
好问题。这取决于提问的人是谁。
你是空洞调查协会的成员？哈哈，“办公室”怎么会有危险呢！
你是盗洞客？空洞（×），聚宝盆（√）！
你是以骸？哇哦……欢迎回家！
你是普通平民？请参考下文信息。


空洞里有什么？
一、攻击一切外来活物的异形怪物。
二、像空气一样无处不在的未知物质，具有超高资源潜力但也伴随着神秘侵蚀性。
三、被上一条物质附着侵蚀，正在慢慢变异且逐渐丧失意志的倒霉蛋。
四、无法无天的歹徒。是的，空洞里也有暴徒强盗。真是无可救药。
五、无惧空洞危险的狂人们。比如盗洞客、绳匠或者单纯的疯子。真是无药可救。
六、官方机构的工作人员，唯一指定救星。


==空洞自救贴士==
1.不要乱跑。请记住，空洞内的空间是无序且紊乱的。
2.找一个安全的角落，等待救援人员到场。
3.如果被以骸、侵蚀体或其它危险因素发现，不得不逃跑时，请往呼吸起来感觉更轻松、清新的方向逃跑。
4.请相信空洞调查协会官方认可的调查员，不要与“绳匠”或“盗洞客”为伍。

39 // BUILD A CHILD SITE: THE TRANSFERABLE RULES

#

Rule

1

Delivery: an SPA shell served for every path (with a static loader inside it), one webpack runtime, two vendor bundles, one app bundle, route chunks on demand, CSS injected per component, SDK scripts loaded before the app.

2

Scale: author in rem on a 2560-wide desktop canvas and a 750-wide phone canvas; html font-size = 100 × clientWidth ÷ designWidth, clamped to [1440, 2560] on desktop; hide the root until the first value is set.

3

Trees: a desktop route tree and a phone route tree with the same names (m- prefix), chosen by user agent in the shell, sharing the store, the API client and the dictionaries.

4

Data: one content API with getContentList / getContent / getChildTree, channel ids as configuration, records with sTitle / sIntro / sContent (HTML) / sExt (JSON of named images) / dates / iInfoId; lists page at 7, 9, 10, 50 or 200 as the component needs.

5

Chrome: a fixed 1rem header with a 19.2rem wrapper (logo, five nav entries, more-menu, download, music, share, account); a fixed sidebar pager on the home page; a three-part footer (own social bar + back-to-top, subscription SDK, corporate footer SDK with the language picker).

6

Home: six full compositions (KV + download, characters, videos, news, world, feature) each built from one or two Swiper instances (fade for the stage, slidesPerView auto for strips, loop for banners), a sidebar that both drives and follows the scroll.

7

Inner pages: fade stage + pagination + voice player + faction rail (character); latest slider + tabs (?category) + 9-per-page grid + pager (video and news); a 12.8rem reading column with a back control and an info bar (article); a looped slide deck with slideToTop entrances (world); a document template with a pdf viewer fallback (company).

8

Tokens: ink #222122 on #e8e8e8/#efefef, black panels, accent #d8fa00 (hover #c6e800), white on dark; display faces per language with a language font variable; sizes .16–.46rem; spacing in tenths of a rem; z-index 99 for page chrome, SDK overlays above.

9

Motion: 0.3 s entrances (Vue transitions), Swiper 300 ms slides, 800 ms world slides, 20 s marquee, 0.5 s loader loop; hover = scale 1.1–1.12 or colour inversion only.

10

Audio: one looping background track behind a persisted mute toggle; per-record voice clips with a progress ring.

11

Services you must replace: the content API (host it yourself with the same shapes), the account SDK, the subscription widget, analytics and APM, the download platform list; everything else is a file and is archived on this host.

The mirror lets those calls go to their hosts, where the browser blocks them for a foreign origin exactly as on the local mirror; a child site replaces them with its own consent, login and analytics.

C. The mirror

OBSERVED — The mirror is the archived shell served at every route of both trees (— pages: the five sections, the company documents, — archived articles and — world entries, plus 404.html so the SPA router answers any other path), with two changes made only in the document head: the CDN references in the shell point at the archive, and one adapter script (mirror/adapter.js) answers the CMS API from the archive, serves i18n JSON and archived media from this host, and lets anything not archived reach its original URL. — CMS answers and — SDK files are served from rewritten copies under mirror/ (media URLs pointed at the archive); the originals stay untouched. Routes: /zh-cn/main, /zh-cn/character, /zh-cn/video, /zh-cn/news, /zh-cn/world, /zh-cn/company/privacy, /zh-cn/company/terms, /m/zh-cn/main.

MEASURED — tools/verify-mirror.mjs loaded the mirror from a plain static server: 15 of 15 checks passed — ✓ home: loader finished from the archive; ✓ home: header, six sections and footer rendered; ✓ home: CMS API answered from this host (no request reached sg-public-api-static); ✓ home: nothing fetched from the live CDN or the live site; ✓ home: character and video swipers populated; ✓ client navigation to the character page (router push, no reload); ✓ news index: list, tabs and pager from the archive; ✓ news index: second tab answered from the archive; ✓ article 166535: renders its archived record; ✓ article 166535: images served from this host where archived; ✓ world page: slides from the archive; ✓ handbook route /zh-cn/news/7013 renders the handbook inside the news template; ✓ mobile tree: /m/zh-cn/main renders the mobile home from the archive; ✓ no JavaScript errors from the site code; ✓ no missing files on this host.

'?' + q : ''); }; const answer = u => { const k = canonical(u); for (const [re, file] of Object.entries(OVERRIDE)) if (new RegExp(re).test(k)) return file; return API[k] || null; }; XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function (m, u, ...r) { if (m === 'GET') { const a = answer(u); if (a) u = location.origin + a; else { const l = localFile(u); if (l) u = l; } } return open.call(this, m, u, ...r); }; // this handbook page: window.__MIRROR_OVERRIDE = { 'getContent\\?.*iInfoId=7013': '/handbook/handbook-content.json' }

D. What this changes for a child site

RULE FOR A CHILD SITE — Build the backend to answer the archived requests in the archived shapes (archive/api/index.json is the contract), serve media from your own CDN with the same record fields, keep the SDK calls behind your own consent and login, and use the mirror as the reference rendering: open a mirrored page and a child page side by side at 1440 × 900 and at 390 × 844 and compare.

INFERRED — With the archive and the mirror on the same host as this handbook, the only things a reader cannot take from here are HoYoverse's live services and the rights to the material: everything that can be a file is a file.
